about: Ponytail by Dietrich Gebert (MIT): a lazy-senior-dev mode for the smallest complete code change, plus diff review, whole-repo audit and a ledger of deliberate shortcuts. Listed as upstream entries pinned to one commit; only the skills/ folder is used, never the plugin hooks, statusline band or installers. Re-import with: python3 scripts/import-collection.py collections/ponytail.json

exclude.ponytail-help: a reference card for the upstream plugin: its statusline band, plugin-marketplace auto-update and a ~/.config default-mode file are not shipped by this Hub entry (updates come through the Skill Hub); the levels it lists are in ponytail's own SKILL.md
exclude.ponytail-gain: only prints the upstream benchmark scoreboard; it does nothing in a project
